description.value: North Perk Café is the community café embedded inside MakeSpace North Park, Victoria's inclusive makerspace and woodshop in the North Park neighbourhood, minutes from downtown. It functions as a coffee-fuelled coworking and creative hangout space where drop-in visitors mix with makers, fabricators, and workshop participants. The broader MakeSpace facility has received coverage from CBC, CTV, and Chek TV and is positioned as a creative-economy hub for YYJ residents.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 81m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM entry names 'North Perk Cafe' and the website (makespacefor.art) confirms it exists as the in-house café of MakeSpace North Park, described as 'Home to the MakeSpace North Park Society and the North Perk Café' and open 7 days a week. The website is for the parent makerspace organisation, not a dedicated café site, so café-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are not described. OSM tags indicate free internet access but the website does not confirm this, so per rules it is left null.
concerns: No street address available in OSM tags or anywhere on the website; location can only be narrowed to the North Park neighbourhood of Victoria.
The OSM website URL resolves to MakeSpace North Park (the parent makerspace), not a dedicated North Perk Café page; café-specific amenity details are largely absent.
The only phone number on the website (250-896-6446) is listed for partnership/executive-director enquiries, not as the café's main contact line.
OSM tags indicate free internet access (internet_access=yes, internet_access:fee=no) but this is not confirmed by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: North Perk Café is a real, actively operating café confirmed open 7 days a week by the parent organisation's website. It is a publicly accessible café workspace suitable for touring cyclists seeking coffee and a place to sit.
enrichment_extras.notes: North Perk Café is a sub-entity operating within MakeSpace North Park; the OSM record captures the café specifically, but all online presence routes through the parent organisation's site at makespacefor.art.

wow_evidence: community café embedded inside MakeSpace North Park, Victoria's inclusive makerspace
